description: Drops one field and its column from a collection, discarding the data in it permanently. Requires confirm: true. Relations pointing at the field can be left dangling, so check analyze_relationships first; use update_field to hide a field in the admin app instead of destroying it, delete_collection to drop the whole table. Not reversible, so take get_schema_snapshot beforehand when the model may need restoring.
name: delete_field
